# Compute most common genre per playlist
from collections import Counter

playlist_genres = {}
for pl in all_playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    # Find max count
    max_count = max(counter.values())
    # Get all genres with max count
    top_genres = [g for g, c in counter.items() if c == max_count]
    # If tie, pick the one that appears first in the playlist? Or alphabetical? We'll pick first encountered.
    most_common = top_genres[0]
    playlist_genres[pl_id] = most_common
    print(f"Playlist {pl_id} ({pl['title']}): genres={dict(counter)}, most_common={most_common}")
